handoffs.change: In the typed-word keydown handler (around line 251), replace `run(id)` with `triggerEgg(id)`. The EGG_EVENT listener at line 211 then runs the egg exactly once. Do not also call run(id). The engine has no listener-order requirement: it voices egg:trigger and hunt:found one task later, so Lumos and Nox work whichever listener runs first.
handoffs.why: The engine voices eggs only through egg:trigger. Today, typed spells (lumos, nox, parley, 'i solemnly swear', aal) make no sound (review #1 high; spec §10.3 Eggs; P3-9 #2).

handoffs.change: Fire the Snitch's appearance with `triggerEgg("snitch")` (EggHost's run('snitch') is a no-op, so this is safe). Fire every EggHotspot activation through `triggerEgg(registryId)`. The catch keeps `catchSnitch()`, and the engine plays snitch-ting from SNITCH_EVENT.
handoffs.why: snitch-flutter and the hotspot egg cues play only on egg:trigger (review #1).

handoffs.change: When the hidden kraken or the quadcopter-lift egg fires, call `triggerEgg("hidden-kraken")` or `triggerEgg("quadcopter-lift")`. Never call sound.cue for these.

handoffs.change: In the click handler, call `sound.borrow()` first, synchronously, before any other await: `const restore = await sound.borrow(); emit("dc:start")`. On stop, `emit("dc:stop", …)`, then call `restore()` about 1.6 s later so the reel-runout is heard (restore mutes at once). Under Pause the master is already silent.
handoffs.why: Before borrow resolves, the engine (which voices dc:start) may not exist yet (review #9). The facade now also holds sound.cue calls for up to 1 s while the engine loads, but page events cannot be held.

notes: FIXED #1 (high): blocking handoffs to W2-HUNT (egg-host typed words, snitch, hotspots), plus W2-CARDS (kraken) and W3-IDIOTS (quadcopter). Probe checks eggs.typed (type 'parley', expect parley-creak) and eggs.lumos added. Every egg must go through triggerEgg; this is documented in cues.ts EGG_CUES. The engine cannot fix this from inside my globs.

FIXED #2: engine `whenLive()`. When running but the context is still resuming, play() and playFile wait for ctx.resume() (giving up after 1.5 s). The `last` dedupe is set only when the cue is actually voiced. A second cause was also found and fixed: EggHost re-registers its EGG_EVENT listener whenever `run` changes (its deps include `reduced`), so under Pause it runs AFTER the engine. egg:trigger and hunt:found are now voiced one task later (setTimeout 0).

FIXED #3: check #9 calls ctx.gate once per line whose SOUNDS.md rows (any row with the same id, so the 'as above' MP3 rows count) say 'to approve' or 'to confirm'. The release gate is documented in SOUNDS.md §1. The DP-9 handoff is above.

FIXED #4: store split. The static store.ts keeps the snapshot, the wish, synchronous ensureContext() inside the click, and loadImpl(). The new lazy lib/audio/store-impl.ts holds turn, sync, the nox grace, armGesture, visibility and engine creation; it loads in parallel with ./engine on the first unmute (or alone, with no context, after a reload with sound on, to arm the first press). Trade-off: the lazy chunk is now estimated about 0.5 KB over the ≤ 10 KB soft line. The engine now measures from Object.keys(RECIPES) so CUE_IDS can be tree-shaken out of that chunk.

FIXED #5: impact-flash is now a flash-powder 'poof' (bandpass 700→2200 Hz with a swell, a brown-noise body, attacks of 35–60 ms, LEVELS −21). flag-snap is now a canvas flap (band-passed flutters near 1.2 kHz with 12 ms attacks, a brown body, no 3.2 kHz white cracks). SOUNDS.md is updated. The P3-9 #5 manual listen is still the W2 assembler's job.
FIXED #6: armGesture ignores presses inside [data-motion-toggle] as well as [data-sound-toggle] (store-impl.ts). Verified in harness B.

FIXED #7: shouldRun() returns false under OS reduced motion before the grace test. The grace runs setRunning(true, sfxOnly) with a new bedGate node between the time-slow lowpass and the master, so the bed stays shut while the snuff and the line play.

FIXED #8: a `timed` registry. setRunning(false) disarms every bed `every` timer and re-triggered loop; setRunning(true) re-arms them. retire() stops a bed at once when not running. A loop never re-arms while not running.

FIXED #9: the facade holds sound.cue calls made while sound is on but the engine is still loading (≤ 1 s, at most 8) and flushes them when the engine is ready. Engine readiness now runs sync() before the hooks, so held cues and beds play. The W3-CINEMA handoff wording is fixed.

FIXED #10: only `letterbox` close is voiced, and MIN_GAP drops a letterbox-whum within 1.2 s of the previous one. Probe check letterbox.once added. The lab pad is relabelled 'letterbox open (silent)'.

FIXED #11: BedFollower renders nothing on /lab/** (the header's toggle no longer forces 'house' and turns the storm off over the bench). Entry cues are now once per page view in module scope, so Pause unmounting and remounting the follower no longer replays projector-start or reel-runout. The SoundToggle note id now comes from useId(), because two toggles (header + lab) under RM/Pause rendered duplicate id='sound-toggle-note'. The lab page comment no longer claims 'no site chrome'.

The review text reached me truncated in the middle of #11 ('Under RM/Pause, …'). Finding #12 (the 7th low) was never received. I handled the RM/Pause effects I could find (duplicate note ids, follower remount); the reviewer should re-send #12 if it is something else.
No findings were rejected; all 11 received were verified as real.

Verification harness (outside the repo): scratchpad/w2sound/fix/{build.cjs,run.cjs,run-old.cjs,size.cjs,bundle-gz.cjs}. It transpiles lib/audio to browser ESM with stubs and drives headless Chromium. The original builder harness (run-old.cjs) still passes: 58/58 recipes calibrated, max peak −6.5 dBFS, no page errors.

For Aryan, unchanged: all five TTS lines need a listen. 'I solemnly swear…' and 'Mischief managed' are quotations awaiting his approval. The Higgsfield terms are 'to confirm'. Check #9 now holds all five as release gates once they are in public/audio.
